South beam centerline: 63 in south of wall.

East column centers shifted 12¾ in west.
North columns remain at original Y = 253 in.
New north face is 18 in beyond that row.
Beam connections and sizes remain to develop.
Sources: labeled framing plan / member register; earlier rendered model for beam widths, columns and loft deck.
